biggest_catch: No advertiser match means no pay — the amounts only apply once you are actually chosen for a campaign.
catches: You are only paid if an advertiser selects you — signup alone earns nothing.
$50+/month is for rear-window decals; up to $400/month requires a full vehicle wrap.
Programs average 6-24 months; work is not guaranteed or continuous.
You must continue to drive normally for the duration of the program.

steps: Fill out the driver registration form on freecarmedia.com.
If an advertiser selects you, you are contacted by email.
Get the rear-window decal or full wrap installed.
Drive your normal routine; get paid monthly for the duration of the program (typically 6-24 months).
